In Cobble ValleyWhat is this?
  • Catching and healing aren't held back: Poké Balls, the Healing Machine, the PC, the Pasture, apricorns, berries and potions are Wood Age.
  • Great Balls and Ultra Balls must be learned (quest, teacher, or crafting practice) and belong to the Iron Age.
  • Prize Crates add Poké Balls, potions and Exp. Candy at every age (Books & Prize Crates).
